title: SIF - Sissirat Insane Fighter
description: SIF - Sissirat Insane Fighter — The Townstons wiki
html:
Sissirat Insane Fighter (SIF) is able to solo Sissirat at a low level with few requirements. It is very beneficial as Sissirat drops much gold, many yellows and some purples. If you're lucky a Rainbow will drop. This build has many variants, and there isn't a "best" combination of the skills, just as long as the required skills are equipped and the required gear is equipped to give attribute bonuses.

Contents

  • 1 Skills
  • 2 Strategy / Usage
  • 3 Advantages
  • 4 Disadvantages
  • 5 Suggested Gear
  • 6 Attribute Points

Skills

The Bold skills are required and are used in the main build. The skills with normal text are optional, and can be used for experimental things, which might even turn out better. A try doesnt hurt right?

Butcher 1H Swivel Arm Action Way of the Roo
Gym Freak Poison Resistance Soul Rend
Average BMI Righteous Stomp Acidic Blight
Cleave Holy Roller Shadow Lightning

Cleave and Holy Roller are when you take it seriously, as Holy Roller is level 20 for the first rank. Sissirat's Lair is level 3 to 20, so it caps out at level 25, which means you only have 5 levels left to use Holy Roller. Use Average BMI only when you really have problems keeping your health up. Righteous Stomp might help you get 1 or 2 seconds to take a breath, and spam pots without getting hit again. Shadow Lightning requires you put a few points in INT, but it is very helpful to clean up fodder.

Strategy / Usage

  • Before the fight activate Poison Resistance and 1H Swivel Arm Action. These will help you quite a lot.
  • Then run in the battle and start killing Rattletooth by using Butcher and Soul Rend repeatly. If you have Holy Roller you can use it also. If you have Acidic Blight cast this also and it will make the fight much easier.
  • When Rattletooth is dead move yourself through the little broodlings and start killing Sissirat with Butcher and Soul Rend, and use Holy Roller again when you have it. When your health is getting to a dangerious point hit Righteous Stomp and start spamming pots This will give you a fresh, almost full health bar again.
  • When Sissirat is finally dead, start killing the Venom Spitters. Butcher or Holy Roller will knock them down, which will give you the opportunity to hit with Soul Rend and kill them.
  • When all the Venomspitters are killed, which are usually 3 or 4, start killing the little broodlings. They can be really annoying to chase around. If you have Shadow Lightning a few bolts will take them out.
  • Start gathering Loot. When you are a non-member, its suggested to pick up the non-member purples and a possible rainbow, then start filling your inventory with yellows. Pick up the high stacks of gold, and a possible Kings Coin. A member with the Bling Gnome just surveys the loot quickly for potions or other goodies, then feeds the entire lot to the gnome leaving only the purples or rainbow to pick up. Then move to chests, and reset.

This all can be done in 3 minutes or less. If you have trouble doing this you can put the difficulty to extreme and see how it goes then.

Advantages

  • You are able to solo Sissirat, there is no need to wait for a group or someone else.
  • This method is one of the fastest, and one of the safest.
  • When you can kill all the mobs fast, you can gather loot fast and reset. It is better killing Sissirat twice with a chance on better loot then leaving and coming back for more yellow items.

Disadvantages

  • At level 12-13 it can be a bit hard, and can result in a possible death. It's suggested to set the difficulty lower so that you are able to kill him.
  • Do not be afraid to spam potions, but you do need an average amount of gold to get the potions. When you use more cash in potions than you get each run, you should lower the difficulty until gold income can maintain a full stock of potions.

Suggested Gear

The suggested gear isn't very easy to get, yet far from impossible. Full scale armor is recommended because of its strength, and few endurance. With that the Melee critical chance on it can be handy. Either Dual wield or 2 Handed wield isn't bad. Still it is suggested to Dual-wield because of the added speed. If you use a Two Handed Weapon, use 2H Swivel Arm Action instead of 1H Swivel Arm Action. Strength jewelery is also recommended. Get as much health as you can while maintaining defense etc. When you have full Scale or Crystal armor this can be a good substitute for added health.

Attribute Points

It's suggested that you do 2 Endurance 3 Strength per level, or 1 Endurance and 4 Strength, depending on your health in overall. Do not worry about Mana too much, if you feel like you have less mana than you need you can always add some points in it or wear an Intellect ring.
